content:
The given expression simplifies using trigonometric identities. Group terms in the numerator and denominator:

Numerator: \(\cos 5^\circ \cos 20^\circ - \sin 5^\circ \sin 20^\circ + \cos 35^\circ \cos 50^\circ - \sin 35^\circ \sin 50^\circ = \cos(5^\circ+20^\circ) + \cos(35^\circ+50^\circ) = \cos 25^\circ + \cos 85^\circ.\)

Denominator: \(\sin 5^\circ \cos 20^\circ + \cos 5^\circ \sin 20^\circ - \sin 35^\circ \cos 50^\circ - \cos 35^\circ \sin 50^\circ = \sin(5^\circ+20^\circ) - \sin(35^\circ+50^\circ) = \sin 25^\circ - \sin 85^\circ.\)

Apply sum-to-product formulas:
\(\cos 25^\circ + \cos 85^\circ = 2 \cos 55^\circ \cos(-30^\circ) = \sqrt{3} \cos 55^\circ.\)
\(\sin 25^\circ - \sin 85^\circ = 2 \cos 55^\circ \sin(-30^\circ) = -\cos 55^\circ.\)

Thus \(\tan \theta = \frac{\sqrt{3} \cos 55^\circ}{-\cos 55^\circ} = -\sqrt{3}.\)

The least positive angle with \(\tan \theta = -\sqrt{3}\) is \(180^\circ - 60^\circ = 120^\circ.\)

Answer: 120^\circ
